title: Software design and architecture
audience: a computer science graduate or an experienced self-taught programmer preparing for and starting a software engineering job
purpose: Design software that is easy to change: complexity, coupling and cohesion, abstraction and information hiding, the SOLID principles, composition over inheritance, design patterns, domain modeling, layered and hexagonal architecture, API design, events and microservices, architecture decision records, and evolving legacy systems.
primary_reading: Architecture Patterns with Python, "Cosmic Python" (free online)

weeks.8: Layered and hexagonal architecture: ports and adapters
weeks.9: API design: REST, versioning and errors
weeks.12: Evolving architecture: migrations and legacy systems

blocks.deliverable: Find the coupling problems in supplied code.
Refactor a class hierarchy to use composition.
Apply three patterns to supplied problems.
Week 7 midterm; model a domain and draw its layers.
Design an API for a supplied service.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Design and build: write a design document (domain model, architecture diagram, interfaces and three decision records) for a supplied application, then implement its core in Python with ports and adapters, so that its storage and user interface can be swapped, with tests.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
